401909798.headline: Montana vs. Kansas State prediction: model has Kansas State by 9
paragraphs: Montana (2-2) visits Kansas State at Bramlage Coliseum in Manhattan Monday at 8 PM ET on ESPN+.

Our model makes Kansas State a 8.8-point favorite, projecting an 81-72 final, and gives Kansas State a 77% chance to win. The betting market has Kansas State favored by 14.5 with a total of 154.5. The model leans Montana +14.5 and Under 154.5.
Players to watch: Jordan Clark of Montana, 14.6 points a game; Tyler Thompson of Montana, 9.7 points a game; Clayton Mpiana of Montana, 7 points a game.

flavor: Lumber was Missoula's economic mainstay for about 100 years, and the city remains home to the smokejumpers' headquarters and Region 1 of the U.S. Forest Service.
